text:
zoe: quick thread  pushed a tiny dark-mode pass for the console palette + charts. screenshots in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/obsidian-console

kai: saw it, nice direction. immediate note: the sparkline color feels slightly yellow-green on the panel and clashes with success green.

morgan: agree. current sparkline is #a8d9a3. can we try a desaturated blue instead? maybe #84a6bf

lee_frontend: updated vars in preview branch: `/deploy-preview/499`
CSS snippet:
```
:root {
  --bg: #0b0f12;
  --panel: #0e1215;
  --fg: #dbe9f0;
  --spark: #84a6bf;
  --muted: #8896a3;
}
```

pat_access: accessibility note: small label text (11px) against panel (#0e1215) with --muted (#8896a3) drops to 3.6:1. need 4.5:1 for body text. options: increase size to 12px or use #aebfcf

theme-bot: a11y-check summary: labels 3.6, tooltips 4.2, inline-code 4.8

zoe: for speed let's bump label weight to 600 and revisit size. also chart borders are almost invisible in dark at 1px; propose 1.4px and border color rgba(219,231,238,0.05)

kai: syntax highlight thought: current function color is teal which sits close to metric blues. propose function -> steel (#6b9fb3), keywords -> warm gold (#cfae67), strings -> soft apricot (#d6a58d), comments -> cool gray (#6e7b85)

morgan: prefer functions cooler like #5f8ea0 so it doesn't compete with links which are bright blue

lee_frontend: implemented function color #5f8ea0 in the preview. also increased line widths for charts. preview shows less visual noise

pat_access: rechecked locally: `npx color-contrast '#0e1215' '#aebfcf'` -> 4.63:1. bolding labels + new muted color passes too

zoe: nice. let's run a brief internal compare: obsidian-v1 (current) vs obsidian-v2 (tweaks) for 24h with 30 internal users. theme-bot can you schedule?

theme-bot: scheduled AB run: obsidian-v1 vs obsidian-v2, 24h, 30 users per bucket. will post outcome

lee_frontend: i'll open the PR with vars and chart defaults. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
